key_insight: FlexPart brings different levels of user control into one image-to-3D part generation model. It accepts geometric guidance ranging from sparse points to bounding boxes and masks, letting users choose how much detail to specify.
problem_solved: Existing 3D part generation methods lack the flexibility to support workflows with different levels of geometric guidance within a single model.
method: Use a unified image-to-3D part generation framework called FlexPart.
Support variable-granularity geometric conditions, including sparse points, bounding boxes, and masks.
Integrate heterogeneous guidance through gated adaptive modulation.
impact: FlexPart could make controllable 3D asset creation more adaptable by supporting both lightweight guidance and detailed constraints. Practitioners could accommodate different user workflows without relying on separate models for each guidance type.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: input image and geometric guidance → FlexPart → generated 3D parts.

Fusion diagram illustrating gated adaptive modulation combining different condition types.
Color-coded 3D object highlighting its generated constituent parts.
paper_title: A Unified Framework for Image-to-3D Part Generation via Variable Granularity
paper_authors: Qiwen Gu, Xin Zhou, Xiwu Chen, Zhongyang Zhu, Zhuo Zhang
